correctness.rationale: The graph is exactly the bipartite incidence graph on the ten 2-subsets and ten 3-subsets of a 5-element ground set. The signed edge-triangle simplicial boundary matrix B has rank 6, giving nullity four on each side; forcing-kernel principle implies any forcing set contains at least four vertices from each side. Explicit size-eight witness proves Z(D)=8. An eight-set must thus be 4+4, leaving exactly choose(10,4)^2=44100 finite cases. Independently reconstructed graph adjacency and zero-forcing closure accepted exactly 13520; reconstructed all 240 S5 times complement actions and independently partitioned accepted masks into 67 orbits of sizes 20x1, 60x1, 120x18, 240x47. The source includes complete orbit representative CSV and independently implemented Petersen-graph verifier. This is exhaustive for this finite graph, not an extrapolated family result.
residual_risks: The complete finite enumeration is scoped exactly to the stated graph/order range.
